description: Set or clear DNSSEC DS records for a domain you own. Send records:[{key_tag,algorithm,digest_type,digest}] or enabled:false to clear. dry_run validates only. Refused when the registrar cannot manage DNSSEC through the API. Algorithm 8 or 13 with digest_type 2 is recommended.
name: set_dnssec
title: Set DNSSEC DS records
